description: Synthetic 1-page MinerU content_list_v2 (list of pages, each a list of blocks) on the fixed 1000x1000 canvas, filling the gaps of mineru_content_list_v2: page_aside_text, page_footnote, a paragraph reaching the canvas edge (x1 = 1000) and a tiny 12x10 block. Block order follows the page top to bottom; generated by gen_raw.py.

features.feature: page_aside_text (vertical margin stamp, bbox 28 x 640 canvas units)
features.expect: text/metadata (raw page_aside_text -> middle label aside_text), translate=false (provider_non_body:aside_text), tags metadata+skip_translation, semantic_role=metadata, structure_role=metadata, layout_role=paragraph (filled later; the projection says unknown); derived stays empty

features.feature: page_footnote (page-level footnote, not a table/image footnote)
features.expect: text/page_footnote, layout_role=footnote, semantic_role=metadata, structure_role=footnote, translate=false (provider_non_body:page_footnote), tags footnote/page_footnote/skip_translation

features.feature: paragraph whose bbox reaches the right edge of the canvas (x1 = 1000), with an equation_inline item
features.expect: text/body translate=true; bbox [110,420,1000,500] accepted (validator allows x1 == page width 1000); 3 segments text/inline_formula/text all with the block bbox; after PDF rescale x1 maps to exactly 612 pt

features.feature: tiny paragraph, 12 x 10 canvas units (about 7.3 x 7.9 pt), content '(b)'
features.expect: text/body translate=true; one line/segment with the tiny bbox
text/metadata (header, footer) and text/page_number, all translate=false

geometry_cases.outcome: valid (bounds check uses the 1000x1000 page with 1e-3 tolerance); rescaled to 612 pt wide edge

geometry_cases.intent: narrow, tall block near the left canvas edge

tricky_points: page_aside_text and page_footnote exist only in the v2 vocabulary: the adapter maps page_aside_text -> aside_text (metadata, not translated) and passes page_footnote to the MinerU footnote projection (footnote, not translated, unlike image/table footnotes which are translated).

Both blocks get layout_role paragraph/footnote differently: aside_text ends with layout_role=paragraph in the final document although the projection leaves it unknown; page_footnote has a real footnote layout_role.
Inline equation items have no delimiters; the paragraph text becomes '... three independent cultures n = 3 to give ...' (spaces inserted, formula text embedded in block text).
Every segment, line and span copies the whole-block bbox (no sub-block geometry in content_list_v2).
The canvas is 1000x1000 regardless of the paper size, so rescale to 612x792 is non-uniform (x 0.612, y 0.792): the tiny block becomes about 7.3 x 7.9 pt and the aside stamp about 17 x 507 pt.
